Four tab drafts are in roundup://pad/tab-drafts?project=demo. In short:

- A: `[ Files | Notes ]`, two tabs, text only.
- B: `[ Files | Notes | + ]`, a plus button adds a tab.
- C: `[x Files | x Notes ]`, each tab has a close mark.
- D: `Files / Notes`, a slash list with no frame.

"Scenario ID" is the short name, such as Q12, of one thing the app must do; tests carry it so a failure points to the promise it breaks. The question is whether to take it from the Issue number.

A fix agent already runs on the tab strip, so a pick now reaches it as a message.
